instruction: Candid cinematic still, medium close-up. Outdoors in a sunny grassy field, friends gather. In the foreground, the man in the olive shirt (R3) embraces the red-haired woman (R2) from behind. The red-haired woman, wearing a black off-shoulder top, smiles brightly at the camera, while the man in the olive shirt looks to the left with a pleased expression. In the left background, the man with glasses (R4) sits in a striped shirt, looking away. Bright daylight illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows over a warm, blurred background.
